    data = sys.stdin.read().split()

        return
    n = int(data[0])
    z = data[1] if len(data) > 1 else ''
    k = 0
    count = 0
    max_outside = 0

    for c in z[:n]:
        if c == '_':

                if count > max_outside:
                    max_outside = count
            else:
                if count > 0:
                    words_inside += 1
            count = 0
        elif c == '(':
            k = 1
            if count > max_outside:
                max_outside = count
            count = 0
        elif c == ')':
            k = 0
            if count > 0:
                words_inside += 1
            count = 0
        else:
            count += 1
    if k == 0 and count > max_outside:
        max_outside = count
    print(f"{max_outside} {words_inside}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
